title: the system_word harbor_master tooth retires with its device
intention: test_system_word.py stops driving the harbor_master device, which left class-space in 6ae83e7e1: its tooth and the two PROVES keys naming it retire, so no system_word tooth passes only on a box that still carries a hand-placed launcher.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: test_system_word.py:204 test_the_real_harbor_master_takes_uppercase_show_map_open is red on akienasus, which has no ~/.cairn/devices/harbor_master/0/bin. cairn/devices/harbor_master left class-space in 6ae83e7e1 (cairn-device-absorbs-foundational-infrastructure). On Linux it passes only because a stale hand-placed ~/.cairn/devices/harbor_master/0/bin/harbor_master from Sep 2 still answers, the same class as the hand-placed cairn launcher (50ca14d4489e).
traces_to: Law 9 (a green that holds only because a stale hand-placed launcher answers is a hollow green); Law 5 (a tooth over a retired device is history standing at the working surface).
how: test_system_word.py drops test_the_real_harbor_master_takes_uppercase_show_map_open and the e3cf75c6dc8f PROVES keys 1 and harbor_master_filter that name it, with a comment naming this ticket and saying the device-path fold stands in the dispatcher_device tooth. A declaring proof reads test_system_word.py's AST: every live _cairn call (no fixture env) names a class-space device or bin/cmd command, and every PROVES value names a standing tooth, none the retired one. Live fire: remove any hand-placed ~/.cairn/devices/harbor_master/0/bin on each box.

clauses.claim: every literal first word of a _cairn call in test_system_word.py that swaps in no fixture (CAIRN_CMD_DIR or CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT) names a directory under cairn/devices/ or an entry under bin/cmd/
every value in test_system_word.py's PROVES names a function the file defines, and none names test_the_real_harbor_master_takes_uppercase_show_map_open, which the file no longer defines

decisions.text: D1: test_system_word.py drops the harbor_master tooth and PROVES keys e3cf75c6dc8f 1 and harbor_master_filter, with a retirement comment naming this ticket.
D2: the declaring proof, one tooth per clause, an AST read of test_system_word.py.
